narration: You use your debit card for groceries, gas, Amazon — thinking it's safe because it's real money. Here's what your bank isn't telling you.
visual: Debit card SVG springs up from the bottom of a dark screen. Text fades in: 'YOU USE YOUR DEBIT CARD FOR EVERYTHING.' Red warning badge slams onto screen: 'YOUR BANK HAS A SECRET.'

narration: Federal law caps your credit card fraud loss at zero dollars — literally zero. Your debit card? That's a completely different law with a much higher price.
visual: Light background. Credit card slides in from left with a green badge: '$0 MAX LIABILITY.' Debit card slides in from right with a red badge: '$500+ YOU COULD LOSE.' Black card at bottom: 'THESE AREN'T THE SAME LAW.'

narration: Report debit fraud within two days — you're on the hook for fifty dollars max. Wait three to sixty days and that jumps to five hundred. Miss sixty days entirely? Your bank can legally keep every penny.
visual: Dark background. Animated timeline fills from left to right: Day 0 (fraud hits), Day 2 in green ($50 max loss), Day 60 in yellow ($500 max loss), Day 60+ in red (ALL GONE - unlimited loss). Text below: 'MISS 60 DAYS — YOUR BANK KEEPS EVERY PENNY.'

narration: And while credit card fraud gets reversed overnight, debit fraud investigations take up to ten business days — with your actual money frozen the entire time. Rent, food, and utilities won't wait.
visual: Light background. Bank building SVG rises up with a blue FROZEN badge slamming across it. Calendar counting from Day 1 to Day 10. Three red-bordered bill cards appear: RENT, FOOD, UTILITIES — each labeled 'due now.'

narration: Sixteen billion dollars in debit card fraud hits Americans every year. And sixty-eight percent of us primarily use debit — the card with the least protection — thinking we're being responsible.
visual: Dark background. '$16B' counts up in large red text. Below it, a red progress bar fills to 68% labeled 'AMERICANS WHO USE DEBIT.' Bottom card: 'MOST OF US CHOSE VULNERABILITY — WITHOUT KNOWING IT.'

narration: The fix is simple: use a credit card for all purchases, pay it in full every month, and use your debit card only at the ATM. Same money. Zero fraud liability. Follow for more.
visual: Light background. Three rules spring in with check badges: 1) Credit card SVG + 'CREDIT CARD FOR PURCHASES — $0 LIABILITY.' 2) ATM machine SVG + 'DEBIT FOR ATM CASH ONLY.' 3) Calendar + 'PAY IN FULL EACH MONTH.' Black CTA card: 'FOLLOW FOR MONEY TRAPS YOUR BANK DOESN'T WANT YOU TO KNOW.'
